services.name: Sunset cruise
services.desc: It is a spectacular sight to see the bats emerge from the bridge at sunset! An estimated 1.5 million Mexican free-tailed bats live under the Congress Avenue Bridge. It is the largest urban colony in North America, recognized by National Geographic, The Discovery Channel, and various other news media. Come relax on the lake, observe our unusual attraction, and listen to the narration and history provided by your captain. All bat watching cruises will be on one of our THREE smaller boats, The Southern Star, The Northern Star or The Little

blurb: Guests board environmentally-friendly vessels for narrated sightseeing cruises or sunset/bat watching tours on Lady Bird Lake. The fleet includes a large double-decker paddle-wheel riverboat and smaller boats ideal for sunsets and bat watching. Private charters are available year-round for groups of 30 to 100 people.
extraNote: Located on Lady Bird Lake (formerly Town Lake) in Austin, Texas
